name: 90211 · Beverly Hills, CA
findings: ZIP 90211 (Beverly Hills) has 203 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90211 (Beverly Hills) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90211 (Beverly Hills) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.2 times the typical level).
